explanation_full: The Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) identifies VFA as the most important feature with a score of 0.7931, followed by Butyrate (0.7902) and Acetate (0.7772). In terms of model performance, the KNN model achieved the best results, reporting an R² of 0.81717 and an MSE of 0.012810. Furthermore, the incremental feature analysis shows that adding 9 features resulted in the highest KNN score (0.830140), suggesting a strong cumulative effect from a larger feature set.
